verdict.rationale: Steel's open-source steel-browser repo ships a pre-built Docker image combining the API and UI. It drives Chrome via Puppeteer/CDP, so you can connect with Puppeteer, Playwright or Selenium, which points to a self-hostable local browser API that needs no cloud account. However, every documented agent integration (Claude Agent SDK, AgentKit, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Pi) describes running against a Steel cloud session, and no evidence documents a local-development workflow. missing for 10: explicit docs for pointing the SDK/CLI/agent integrations at a self-hosted local instance, confirmation that no account or API key is required locally, hands-on corroboration of local agent runs.
